title: Integral constructible module objects form a weak Serre class
statement: Let ℓ be prime and E a finite normed extension of ℚ_ℓ. With the internal continuous integral coefficient ring of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], on any scheme X with noetherian underlying space, the property of being stratified pro-etale locally finitely presented is closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions in the category of internal coefficient modules.

source.place: Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3), integral presentation comparison

proof.text: Apply the coefficient-dependent integral kernel closure theorem.

Specialize the proved generic cokernel and extension closure theorem to the actual continuous integral coefficient ring and combine the three closure classes. The constructibility property is identical in all three factors.

proof_origin.note: B4: fully proved from integral kernel closure and the generic cokernel/extension presentation argument. Kernel closure is the only remaining hole.

lean.statement:
theorem integralConstructible_serre (X : Scheme.{u})
    [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X] :
    ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderKernels
        (IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) ∧
      ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderCokernels
        (IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) ∧
      ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderExtensions
        (IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X))
